checkpoints.title: Ask page from design-system tokens
contracts: GET / renders the empty, answered, referred, and refused states from the q query parameter; /app.css uses only --ay-* tokens; /tokens.css serves the design system's tokens.css; CSP default-src 'self'
instrumentation: the page records benefits_visit for a pseudonymous visitor cookie and asks through the workflow

checkpoints.title: benefits-qa command serving page, API, and health check
contracts: benefits-qa -addr -tokens -events: one mux with web, api, and /healthz; -events appends Application Insights lines; graceful shutdown on SIGTERM
instrumentation: logs the serving address on start

checkpoints.title: deploy/serve.sh, the [verify] seed command
contracts: serve.sh builds the example, starts it detached on 127.0.0.1:$BQA_PORT (default 8787), replaces a previous instance by pid file, and waits for /healthz
instrumentation: prints the URL, pid, and log path; prints the log when /healthz never answers
